description.short: Project-managed HVE Squad planning and delivery in Cowork
description.full: Adds an HVE project-management workflow to Copilot Cowork and connects it to the HVE Squad MCP server. The skill creates or opens a OneDrive or SharePoint project folder, carries project context across stages, saves returned artifacts, and checkpoints each HVE-managed interaction. Cowork discovers the server's enabled tools at runtime; squad work remains server-side, governed, and advisory.

agentConnectors.description: Governed squad stages served by the hve-squad MCP server (squad-guided / embedded).
